needs.proposedSignature: static `{ kind: 'ability-cost-alter'; amount: Amount; more?: true; who?: 'you' | 'opponent' | 'any'; ability?: 'equip' | 'activated' | 'loyalty'; filter?: Filter; condition?: Condition }`
needs.semantics: 'Equip abilities you activate cost {2} less to activate', 'Abilities you activate of creatures cost {1} less'. The cost-alter family's cost-alter static hangs off the CAST cost path only, so nothing today changes what an activated ability costs (CR 601.2f is reached through 602.2b for abilities).
needs.clause: Equip abilities you activate cost {2} less to activate.

needs.proposedSignature: `{ op: 'blocks-if-able', target: TargetSpec | Ref, attacker?: Ref, duration: 'eot' }` — with `attacker`, the requirement is 'blocks THAT creature if able' rather than 'blocks if able'
needs.semantics: 'Up to one target creature blocks it this combat if able' names both the blocker and the attacker it must block. Today blocks-if-able (combat-restr) gives the blocker the first attacker it can block, and lure is the attacker-side 'all creatures able to block it do so'; the paired form has no expression. blockFixup already resolves requirements per attacker, so this is a new marker rather than a new pass.
